_about: Copied to .harness/cloud.json by init; filled in Phase 0 when the user chooses where ASDR deploys for TESTING. Never put keys, passwords or tokens here: ASDR uses the cloud CLI's own sign-in (aws sso login / az login / gcloud auth login). Every deploy still asks the user first, uses a least-privilege role, is tagged and gets a time-to-live; production is never touched.
account_hint: <AWS account alias, Azure subscription name or GCP project id — not a secret>
deploy_role: <the least-privilege role or service account ASDR deploys with>
